Here is a go-to summary of the statistical tests carried out and the effect
sizes returned by each function. This should be useful if one needs to find
out more information about how an argument is resolved in the underlying package
or if one wishes to browse the source code. So, for example, if you want to know
more about how the one-way (between-subjects) ANOVA is carried out, you can run
`?stats::oneway.test` in your R console.
